meta.name: migrate-nanoclaw
meta.description: Extracts user customizations from a fork, generates a replayable migration guide, and upgrades to upstream by reapplying customizations on a clean base. Replaces merge-based upgrades with intent-based migration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 fork 的自定义迁移到上游版本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护着一个上游项目的 fork，想升级又不丢失自定义改动。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate fork customizations to upstream releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a fork of an upstream project and want to upgrade without losing custom changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先把你对 NanoClaw 的定制提取成一份可重放的迁移指南(写明改动内容和意图),升级时在干净的上游代码上按指南重新应用这些定制,不再靠 git merge,因此不会产生合并冲突。
howto.when: 当你要求把 fork 的 NanoClaw 升级到上游新版本、提到“迁移我的定制”,或说要避免 git 合并冲突时,这个技能会接管。

say.text: 帮我提取这个 NanoClaw fork 里的所有定制,生成迁移指南。
say.note: 会先检查工作区并备份,再分析改动。

say.text: 升级到上游新版本,但按迁移指南重新应用我的改动,别动数据目录。
say.note: 会在干净上游上重新应用定制,跳过合并。

say.text: 我不想用 git merge,改用迁移方式升级。
say.note: 会评估改动规模并询问处理方式。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude extracts your customizations from a NanoClaw fork into a replayable markdown migration guide (what changed and why), then upgrades to upstream by reapplying those changes on a clean base — no git merge, so no merge conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to upgrade a NanoClaw fork to upstream, mention migrating your customizations, or want to avoid git merge conflicts.

say_en.text: Extract all my customizations from this fork and generate a migration guide.
say_en.note: Checks the tree, creates a rollback point, analyzes changes.

say_en.text: Upgrade to upstream and reapply my changes from the guide, skipping data dirs.
say_en.note: Reapplies customizations on clean upstream, skipping merge.

say_en.text: I don't want git merge — use the migration approach instead.
say_en.note: Assesses scope and asks how to handle your changes.
